name: How does Website Entity Optimization differ from traditional SEO?

mainEntity.name: How does Website Entity Optimization differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO primarily focuses on keywords, backlinks, and technical factors to improve organic rankings. Website Entity Optimization, while incorporating some SEO principles, goes deeper by emphasizing the semantic understanding of content. It involves identifying and structuring explicit entities within your website using schema markup and content relationships, rather than just keyword density. The goal is to provide clear answers directly to users and AI systems, leading to better visibility in answer engines and rich search results, beyond just a blue link.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO targets keywords and rankings; Entity Optimization focuses on semantic understanding and structuring content for direct answers in AI and search engines.
